Maharashtra on 3 January, 2024
Author: Prakash D. Naik

Bench: Prakash D. Naik
 1 of 2 7.APL.1156.2016.doc
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction
 Criminal Application No.1156 Of 2016
 Sunil Shankar Raut (Nominee) and another Applicants
 versus
 The State of Maharashtra Respondent
 Mr.Kirti Parekh, Advocate for Applicants.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Coram : Prakash D. Naik, J.
 Date : 3rd January 2024
 Pc :
 1.
The applicant has challenged the order issuing process dated  16th April 2016.
The complaint was filed alleging contravention of  provisions of Food Safety and Standard Act.
One of the grievance of  Applicant is that the order issued u/s.427 of Food Safety and  Standard Act does not refer to the names of Applicants.
Reliance is  placed on the decision of this Court in the case of A.K.Shirbhate  (Food Inspector) Vs. Ramlal @ Ramnath and another (1990[2)-Food  Adulteration Cases-257).

entities.text: A.K.Shirbhate  (Food Inspector) Vs. Ramlal @ Ramnath and another (1990[2)-Food  Adulteration Cases-257)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 2. Learned APP submits that there is sufficient material to  prosecute Applicants.
The Trial Court has issued process.
The  concerned officer is not present for giving instructions.
3. It is pertinent to note that interim order was granted by this  Court on 25th October 2016.
The application was adjourned on  several occasions for want of instructions.
